requirements.title: Sequence association is limited to explicit-shape and assumed-size dummy arrays
requirements.definition: Sequence association applies only for explicit-shape or assumed-size array dummy arguments; the remaining sequence-association rules have that precondition.

pending.sequence-association-dummy-array-precond: Use one explicit-shape dummy and one assumed-size dummy in future source controls, both receiving the same actual element sequence; companion assumed-shape controls keep ordinary argument association separate.

requirements.title: Certain actual arguments represent element sequences
requirements.definition: An array expression, array element designator, default character scalar, or C character kind scalar represents an element sequence.

pending.array-expression-element-sequence: Pass an integer array expression [11,22,33] to an explicit-shape rank-one dummy and verify the dummy sees 11, 22, and 33 in order.
pending.array-element-designator-element-sequenc: Pass a simply contiguous integer array element a(2) to a dummy of extent 3 after initializing a to [5,7,9,11]; verify the dummy observes 7, 9, and 11.
pending.default-character-scalar-element-sequenc: Pass a default character scalar initialized to "ABCD" to a character dummy array of length 2 and verify elements "AB" and "CD".
pending.c-character-scalar-element-sequence: Use iso_c_binding c_char and pass a scalar character(kind=c_char,len=4) with contents "WXYZ" to a length-2 C-character dummy array; verify elements "WX" and "YZ".

requirements.title: Non-character sequence association follows array element order or scalar value
requirements.definition: For non-character dummy arguments, an array expression contributes elements in array element order, a simply contiguous array element designator contributes that element and following elements in array element order, and a scalar contributes that scalar.

pending.noncharacter-array-expression-element-or: Use RESHAPE([1,2,3,4],[2,2]) as the actual for an explicit-shape rank-one dummy of extent 4 and verify the dummy receives [1,2,3,4], the column-major array element order.
pending.noncharacter-array-element-tail: Initialize a rank-one target [10,20,30,40], pass element a(3) to an explicit-shape dummy of extent 2, and verify [30,40].
pending.noncharacter-scalar-singleton-sequence: Pass a scalar integer 77 to an explicit-shape dummy of extent 1 and verify the single element is 77.

requirements.title: Character sequence association groups storage units by dummy character length
requirements.definition: For nonzero-length default or C character dummy arguments, the actual contributes a storage-unit sequence from an array expression, simply contiguous designator tail, or scalar; consecutive groups of storage units of dummy character length become the element sequence, stopping before a short final group.

pending.character-array-storage-units: Pass a default character array ["ab","cd","ef"] to a length-3 dummy array of extent 2 and verify the grouped elements are "abc" and "def".
pending.character-designator-tail-storage-units: Pass a simply contiguous character array element beginning at the second element of ["aa","bb","cc"] to a length-2 dummy and verify elements "bb" and "cc".
pending.character-scalar-storage-units: Pass scalar "wxyz" to a length-2 dummy array of extent 2 and verify "wx" and "yz".
pending.character-grouping-by-dummy-length: Use scalar "abcdef" with a length-3 dummy array and verify exact elements "abc" and "def"; a length-2 mutation would produce a different grouping.
pending.character-short-final-group-ignored: Use scalar "abcde" with length-2 dummy extent 2 and verify only "ab" and "cd" are accessible through the dummy, with no assertion about the leftover "e".

requirements.title: Zero-length character sequence length is processor-supported maximum
requirements.definition: For zero-length default or C character dummy arguments, the element sequence contains zero-length elements up to the maximum number supported by the processor.

pending.zero-length-character-elements: Use a zero-length character dummy array and verify any referenced dummy element has LEN 0 after a conforming caller establishes the dummy bounds through a separately known extent.
pending.zero-length-character-processor-maximum: No portable oracle fixes the processor-supported maximum count for zero-length character elements; future fixtures may use only caller-specified extents known not to exceed supported limits.

requirements.title: Sequence association permits rank and shape disagreement subject to element count
requirements.definition: An actual argument representing an element sequence and corresponding to an array dummy argument is sequence associated with that dummy; actual and dummy rank and shape need not agree, but the dummy element count shall not exceed the sequence length.

pending.sequence-associated-array-dummy: Pass a rank-two integer array RESHAPE([1,2,3,4],[2,2]) to a rank-one explicit-shape dummy of extent 4 and verify [1,2,3,4].
pending.rank-shape-disagreement-permitted: Use the same rank-two actual and rank-one dummy with a marker initialized to -17; successful execution sets the marker to 88 after verifying all four values, distinguishing this permission from ordinary shape conformance.
pending.dummy-element-count-not-exceed-sequence: Positive source control uses a dummy extent exactly equal to the sequence length. A mutation increases only the dummy extent by one and is retained as a program-restriction contrast with no diagnostic facet.
